audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was framed as generic magic poke your shield absorbs, when the actual pressure is a Death's Hand cooldown that falls to 3 seconds and a passive that converts every landed spell into permanent health.
audit.why: Death's Hand is 7/6/5/4/3 at 750 range, and Ravenous Flock's Soul Fragments heal Swain and permanently raise his maximum health — the poke you 'absorb' still pays him.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10, but the cost of a conceded lane is higher here than elsewhere: every trade he lands is permanent stats, not just damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2] through phases[5] all read 'Skill' while win[2..5] read Swain, and the full-layer whys for rows 4 and 5 described Kassadin taking the lane over.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension at 6 and a Liandry's first item both keep those stages his; the flip is two items.
audit.corrected: phases[2..5] set to Swain with rows 4 and 5 rewritten to match. Content win[] rows were already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass rather than the outbound one, Nevermove cancels Null Sphere's channel, and Demonic Ascension only persists while Swain is draining a champion.
audit.why: Riot's text says the wave 'then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits', and that the demon form 'is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions'. Null Sphere is a channel any CC ends.
audit.corrected: Dodge the second pass, not the first. Never start Null Sphere with Nevermove available. And leaving his 650-range drain is what ends his ultimate — walking away is a counter, not a retreat.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.why: Nevermove 12s to 10s, Demonic Ascension a flat 120s, Death's Hand 7s falling to 3s, Vision of Empire 22s to 18s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, with Nevermove identified as the punishable one because it is his only lockdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was a trailing clause with no timing attached.
audit.why: Ravenous Flock heals him off Soul Fragments and Demonic Ascension drains, so Grievous Wounds decides whether your two-item all-in actually kills.
audit.corrected: Buy anti-heal before your second damage item, not after — it is what makes the level 16 all-in stick.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing noted Vision of Empire's range.
audit.why: It reaches 5500 at rank 1 and 7500 at rank 5, so he influences other lanes without leaving mid — and it reveals whoever it hits.
audit.corrected: A Swain who never walks anywhere is still applying pressure at 5500 to 7500 range; ping the cast, not the roam.

audit.why: 53.18% across 865 games matches losing six stages and owning the last.
